question: Reject incoherent run receipts and changed bound artifacts before generating derived reports.
implementation: Strict snapshot admission, exact typed metric consistency, confined artifact hash verification with producer identity, precise verification scope, and atomic output that protects raw receipts from any recognized run.
attribution: The strict writer/config changes were published in an earlier pass. Only the report-reader/derived-output implementation and new tests are newly authored here. Quantizer and uncertainty repairs are preserved from the newer PR4 parent.

initial_new_report_cases.baseline: public report/reader code identical on both selected parents; previous strict writers combined before this test

final_complete_suite.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -o addopts= -q

tests.static_checks: Ruff E4,E7,E9,F on new/changed report runtime and new tests passed
tests.preserved_claims: All nine existing claim-index analysis digests verified unchanged

peer_findings.finding: Custom report output could overwrite raw files of another run.
peer_findings.fix: Identify retained run layouts in every output ancestor, including another root; eight cross-run regression cases.

peer_findings.finding: An arbitrarily long JSON exponent caused decimal.InvalidOperation instead of a structured verification error.
peer_findings.fix: Inspect JSON significand digits directly; three file-type regressions.

scope_limitations: Only hashes actually recorded in metrics/events are bound; unreferenced files are counted explicitly as unverified.
Hash agreement and receipt consistency do not authenticate a producer or recompute a scientific metric.
No historical campaign replay or new claim evaluation is implied.
Read snapshots detect normal concurrent advancement; evidence directories are trusted, not adversarial transactional storage.

metrics.note: Fixed is the oracle graph Laplacian; constrained learns nonnegative edge weights. Dense eigendecomposition is not FFT-speed computation.

independent_review.scope: 58 admission cases plus separate cross-run output and extreme JSON exponent probes

initial_findings.issue: Cross-run report destination replaced another run's metrics.json with Markdown
initial_findings.witness: Two independently constructed retained run receipts; write_report(first_root, first_id, out_path=second/metrics.json) changed second raw bytes
initial_findings.closure: Guard recognizes retained run ancestors across the same or a different runs root; witness now raises INVALID_CONFIG and preserves bytes

initial_findings.issue: An extreme finite-decimal exponent raised decimal.InvalidOperation instead of WorldSeriesError
initial_findings.closure: Significand scan fails with VERIFICATION_FAILED while preserving raw bytes
